block.field: High/Low Tick AI Sniper v6 armed — five-tick contract, cadence mode. Sixteen experts mixed by measured skill and gated by the live market regime, a deep online brain that learns from settled windows only, a tie-aware structural prior, and a live ten-outcome payout ladder: the bot buys the position with the highest expected value against what Deriv actually quotes on every cycle it can read, sizing thin reads down to the exchange minimum. Every skip names its gate; every tenth settlement prints the self-audit, every twenty-fifth the expert league, the market DNA, the AI core, the reverse engineering and the execution clock, every fifth the payout ladder and the outcome forecast. Demo first: estimates are not guarantees; confirm equal-extreme settlement with Deriv.

AI is ready but the entry gate held it — a losing-streak cool-off, the DNA floor, the skill floor, the rule's own graded record, the balance percentage, the loss limit or the profit target blocked this entry.
AI session stop — the loss limit, the profit target or the balance rule was reached. Open contracts still settle; restart the bot to begin a new session.
